d.ko: In the mayhem-filled streets of the future where criminal gangs rule and cops fear to tread, only the bounty hunters can free the city from the corrupt fist of felony. Lay waste to the criminal underworld and make a killing in this hard boiled action comedy arcade shooter.
d.en: In the mayhem-filled streets of the future where criminal gangs rule and cops fear to tread, only the bounty hunters can free the city from the corrupt fist of felony. Lay waste to the criminal underworld and make a killing in this hard boiled action comedy arcade shooter.
d.zh: 未来城市充满混乱的街道中，黑帮掌控一切，警察如履寒冰，只有赏金猎人才能将城市从罪恶的堕落之掌中解救出来。将见不得光的地下黑社会一网打尽，在这款硬派搞笑动作类街机射击游戏中大开杀戒。

rv.t: 할인 때 사서 해봤는데 레트로 감성의 맵, 찰진 캐릭터 대사, 꽤 스타일리쉬한 플레이 등 장점이 많은 게임입니다. 하지만 역시 다른 리뷰들처럼 다회차나 아케이드 모드 플레이에 끌릴만한 요소는 없는게 단점이네요. …
Me and my daughter finished this game. I was a able to spend time with my kid explaining some of the pop culture references and easter eggs and nods in the game. …

One of the few games I would give 10/10. Pixel art, action, humor, one-liners, voice acting, music, attention to details, just the correct difficulty, references on 80s movies literally on every corner... Everything just clicks for me. …
Game would not recognize a controller as player 1. Every time I hit the A button It'd ask for player 2 to join. Could not find a fix. …
没有繁琐的操作，纯靠反应和背板策略，枪械的音效质感十足，一玩就上头。
打击感和BGM还是很不错的，BOSS的外貌和技能虽然有区别，但是大都都属于闪现偷袭和特定区域的弹幕，熟悉后还是较简单的
双人比单人体验好，单人难受，射击只能左右。 曲棍球判定大便，我都躲避到她身后了还能打到我，之后是个喊个不停的弱智玩意，恶心的让我开静音打。关底打药的弱智也是设计的无聊要死，一阶段纯纯拖延时间。之后骑摩托的也是弱智，我都跳到他头上了还是掉血
